transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well, I came in because... I just keep having these thoughts lately. Thoughts that my family might be better off if I just didn't wake up. It really scared me, honestly. It scared me enough that I actually went and told my supervisor about it, and... well, that's why I'm here today.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most of the day recently?

I'm not really sure about that, to be honest. I mean... I haven't really paid attention to whether it's most of the day or not. I just know I've been having those thoughts I mentioned... but as for just feeling sad all day, I haven't really noticed.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in doing things you normally enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I mean, I used to mess with my tomato plants out back, or... sand wood at my bench. I'd watch the Falcons, stay after church talking to folks. But lately, I just... I look at all that like it belongs to somebody else. I just don't have any interest in doing any of it right now.
About how long have you been feeling this loss of interest?

This whole change in me... it's been going on for about two weeks now. Right around the time my daughter left Georgia for the military. That's when I really started noticing I just didn't care about any of it anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns over these past two weeks?
No, not really. I mean, I go to bed and get up around the same time I always have. My sleep's been pretty much normal, near as I can tell. I just haven't noticed any difference there.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over these past couple of weeks?

Yeah, my appetite's definitely been off. Most days I really have to make myself eat even just a few bites. It's like I have no taste for anything. Even the food I normally like, whether I'm at the warehouse or sitting at home, it just... it just sits there on the plate until I end up throwing it out.
How have your energy levels been over these past two weeks?

My energy? It's... I guess it's been about normal. I don't really feel physically tired or wiped out or anything. I mean, my body feels fine, I just... I just don't have the drive to actually do much with it right now. But the energy itself hasn't really changed.
Over the past two weeks, have you had any trouble concentrating, focusing, or making everyday decisions?

Yeah, I have. Like, when I'm at the distribution center, I'll just sit there staring at the schedule or a routing sheet, and my mind... it just won't lock in. I can't get it to focus. And making choices, even just little staffing calls about who goes where, lately they just feel a whole lot bigger and harder to figure out than they ought to.
Have you been struggling with feeling worthless or feeling overly guilty about things lately?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep going over my daughter leaving. I can't stop telling myself that I must have failed her somehow. Like... like a better father just would have done something different, you know? It's hard not to feel pretty guilty about the whole thing.
Have you ever experienced a time in your life before this where you felt this way?

Yeah, I have. Looking back on it, these kind of low stretches... they've been coming around for about a year now. But this one right now, especially after my daughter left, it's definitely hit me the hardest.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually 'high', euphoric, or full of energy, needing much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, I have. Right before this low spell hit, actually. I was... well, I was feeling way too fired up, like everything was finally going my way. I had all this energy. But then, on the flip side, I was also just snapping at folks at the distribution center over really small things. Things I normally just let slide, you know? It was like I was running hot, one way or the other.
